method: Primary inspected all four pilot sources and emitted work: iteration parsing, owned row intervals, complete CSR/packed-row traversals, stores, and compiled iteration/row/nonzero backedges. Returned the initial GPU citations for precise arithmetic and complete dispatch coverage; accepted the revised evidence after inspection. No execution or compilation.

checked_examples.omp: Source99-109 and226-242; host852-918 retains row partitioning, CSR multiplication/addition/stores and all three nested backedges.
checked_examples.mpi: Source235-301 covers contiguous row/item partition/scatter/rebasing and repeated local SpMV; host2173-2225 retains timed iteration, row and nonzero loops with actual indexed arithmetic and stores.
checked_examples.cuda: Source143-195 and314-331; native host counter and cudaLaunchKernel paths for Width4(1316-1398), Width8(1550-1633), Width1(1657-1739); SASS has DMUL/DADD, nonzero backedges507/1648/2263 and stores519/1660/2271.
checked_examples.hybrid: Source147-266 constructs/transverses packed row slices and handles the tail; source362-388 covers rank-local ownership and repeated launches; host6009-6034 retains counter/stub loop; SASS23-61 initial bounds/slice/length loads,397-417 batch arithmetic/backedge,895-935 tail arithmetic/backedge/store.

metadata_note: The first proposal's inferred start timestamp is unreliable and preserved as such. v2/v3 record clock-observed revision intervals only. No agent interval is used as a cost or throughput estimate.
remaining_scope: The other36 successfully validated SpMV implementations in the two-model batch.
escalation_policy: Only uncertain/potential-failure findings to Sol-6.1; no blanket stronger-model review.
